surfaces.says: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md at the repository root as project instructions, and one sub-agent definition per Markdown file under .claude/agents/ -- YAML front-matter carrying name and description, the body as the agent's instructions. Taken from the product's documentation; a claim until a run of the product is observed reading what was served. It reads project settings at .claude/settings.json, whose PreToolUse hooks receive the tool event as JSON on stdin (tool_input.file_path, and content / new_string / edits[].new_string) and refuse the tool call when the command exits 2, its stderr shown to the model. Hook payload keys and the exit-2 refusal are measured on a prior hand-built system on this machine (pre_write_context, post_write_block, pre_exec_block proven by receipt); served by THIS kit, not yet observed. Scoped law: it also reads a CLAUDE.md in a subdirectory when it works on files there (nested memory, loaded on demand) -- taken from the product's memory documentation; UNVERIFIED on this machine until a session is observed citing a served scoped file. Skills: one directory per skill under .claude/skills/ holding SKILL.md (front matter `name`, `description`, optional `allowed-tools`) and its supporting files -- taken from the product's skills documentation (fetched 2026-10-16); a claim until a run is observed loading a served skill.
